description: Statistics Norway produced the municipal water supply and wastewater statistics, which describe drinking water quality, leakage, pipe network renewal and preparedness in municipal water supply, and fees, treatment, discharges, plant numbers and sludge in municipal wastewater. The page reports that 99.7 percent of people on municipal supply had satisfactory drinking water in 2025, that about 30 percent of drinking water is lost through leaks, and a renewal rate of 0.6 percent for 2022 to 2024. Coverage is Norway by municipality. The statistics are free to read and download as tables and reports. Caveats: the statistics describe municipal systems only, so private supplies are not covered. Simulation uses: leakage, renewal and capacity indicators for ageing network models and utility planning. Related records: the SINTEF municipal wastewater facilities dataset (data-norway-municipal-wastewater-facilities-sintef).
